project_metadata.name: Engineering Knowledge System (EKS)
project_metadata.description: Schema-driven document registry and knowledge graph system for engineering asset management
project_metadata.purpose: Ingest, extract, and cross-reference engineering documents to build a searchable knowledge graph
project_metadata.status: Phase 1 through I306/I313 closure — schema-driven DB layer fully materialized (2026-08-14): all 53 tables (42 definition + 9 runtime + 2 metadata) created in eks_registry.db via eks_db_config.json; persistent v_* views (discovery_inventory/extraction_results/review_flags) from eks_export_view_config.json; db_manifest provenance table (I312); migration/validation gate (I311); Excel single-workbook export (I309); §24 cross-source audit + output-name literal removal closed (I313 phases 1–3; Phase 4 closure of I313 ✅ + I306 📐 Aligned). See U286–U304, TL053–TL062. I318 de-risking spike (T1.309–T1.312, U305, TL063) completed 2026-08-18 — BaseAssetLoader skeleton delivered (datadrop Excel → column_normalization → conditional_fragments canonical asset records, 18 loader tests). I316 FK orphan resolution (T1.313/T1.314, U308, TL064) completed 2026-08-20 — 55 tables, 0 FK violations / 59 FK pairs, WARNING_FK_ORPHANS level-1 message.

key_modules: engine/core/ - Foundation: registry, revision, config, schema_loader, project_definition (ProjectDefinitionResolver/RuntimeProjectConfiguration, I265), pipeline orchestration, context, base engine, telemetry, validator, factories, setup_validator

engine/core/schema_to_ddl.py + definition_loader.py - Schema-driven DB materialization: all 53 tables rendered from eks_db_config.json (I307/I310), UUIDv5 ids, physical FK enforcement, topological load
engine/core/migration_gate.py - PRAGMA-diff validation/plan gate (additive auto / destructive blocked, backup before destructive, --db-check/--db-apply/--db-force) (I311)
engine/core/manifest.py - db_manifest provenance table writer (schema_version/engine_version/schema_hash/config:* /table:* keys, transactional retried UPSERT) (I312)

engine/pipeline_engine/exporter.py - Config-driven export views (resolve_export_columns/resolve_export_views), workbook export, column-override validation S-C-S-0313 (I308/I309); no hardcoded output literals (I313/T1.307)
engine/parsers/ - Plug-in document parsers (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, DGN, DWG) with parser_router

engine/extractors/ - BaseAssetLoader (I318 de-risking spike): datadrop Excel sheets → column_normalization → conditional_fragments canonical asset records (dotted routing, config-wins/native item_core fallback, pre-materialised nested objects, null/blank tolerance + per-asset HealthScorer, column_coverage pre-check)
engine/discovery/ - CLI entry points for scheduling engines
engine/health/ - CLI entry points for health scorer
ui/backend/ - HTTP API endpoints for independent engine execution (12 endpoints + log streaming); schema-driven export downloads + export_views catalog (I309/I313)
ui/ - Interactive dashboard (phase1_ingestion.html, eks.css, eks.js, ui_help.json)

config/schemas/ - 3-layer schema pattern (base/setup/config) for 8 schema sets + 4 fragments + project definition; DB-layer configs eks_db_config.json (53 tables) + eks_export_view_config.json (3 views, v1.2.0)
data_flows: File Scanner → Parser Router → Parser → Structure Detector → Health Scorer → Document Registry
Schema Loader validates base/setup/config chain with $ref resolution
ConfigRegistry provides SSOT access to global parameters
ProjectDefinitionResolver loads eks_project_definition_config.json → builds immutable RuntimeProjectConfiguration registry → per-module configuration slices (I265)
common.library.config normalizes system_parameters across EKS flat-object and DCC array-entry config shapes

Definition config (eks_db_config.json) → SchemaToDDL/DefinitionLoader → 53 materialized tables in eks_registry.db → persistent v_* views → export files (CSV/XLSX), all names from eks_export_view_config.json (I306–I313)
integration_points: Main server (port 5000) proxies /api/* to Phase 1 backend (port 5001), serves static UI from eks/ui/

core_entities: Document - engineering document with metadata, revisions, structural elements
Asset - plant equipment/instrument with fragment-based schema
Ontology - ISO 15926-aligned class and relationship definitions
Discipline - engineering disciplines (PI, EL, IN, CI, etc.)
terminology: Fragment - reusable property group for asset schema composition
SSOT - Single Source of Truth for global parameters

key_schemas: config/schemas/eks_base_schema.json - Core pipeline definitions (v1.22.0, incl. db-layer shared defs table_spec/column_spec/fk_spec/id_strategy/transform/export_view, system_parameters_def with export_workbook_file_name + export_download_file_name_template)
config/schemas/eks_setup_schema.json - Core property declarations (v1.13.0, incl. db_tables + export_views + db_manifest_keys properties)
config/schemas/eks_config.json - Core config values (v1.14.0, incl. system_parameters.export_workbook_file_name + export_download_file_name_template)
config/schemas/eks_db_config.json - DB-layer SSOT: 53 table specs (42 definition + 9 runtime + 2 metadata), FK pairs, id strategies (v1.1.1, I307/I310/I312)

config/schemas/eks_export_view_config.json - Export view SSOT: 3 default views (view_id/source_table/columns/file_base_name/sheet_name/formats/filter; view_id = export_artifact.artifact_type) (v1.2.0, I307/I308/I309)
config/schemas/eks_doc_base_schema.json - Document metadata definitions (v1.17.0, incl. element_type_code enum 11 values + B3.2 structural_profile_def)
config/schemas/eks_project_definition_config.json - Project Definition SSOT (I265; per-project config — eks_project_rules_config.json retired in T1.196)
config/schemas/eks_doc_config.json - Document element type registry (11 entries, v1.12.0, I283)
config/schemas/eks_document_type_schema.json - Five-section carrier: document_classes/types/family/bindings/templates (v2.3.0, I283 expected_elements + cover_type + structural_profile)

revision_history.author: opencode
revision_history.summary: I311 resolved (2026-08-12) — DB migration/validation gate delivered (T1.297–T1.300 ✅, U294, TL055). Root cause: `_eks_table_relations` PK cross-source misalignment — config declared `id` PK (uuid5) while runtime manifest kept legacy `relation_name` PK → gate correctly blocked every fresh test DB (P1-R-P-0004). Fixed per design review (runtime follows config `id` PK; config SSOT unchanged): schema_to_ddl.py `generate_relations_manifest_ddl()` renders config-shaped DDL (`id VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY, relation_name VARCHAR UNIQUE`) + `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ... EXCLUDED` (DuckDB rejects OR REPLACE on dual-unique) + uuid5 id; registry.py `_init_db()` un-excludes `_eks_table_relations` from config pre-creation; error codes S-C-S-0311/P1-R-P-0004/0005 registered (eks_error_config.json v1.9.0, total_codes 138). Gate wired through eks_engine_pipeline/runner/discovery_cli/health_cli (--db-check/--db-apply/--db-force, non-destructive default policy). Full suite 751 passed / 4 failed (3 pre-existing I288 real-PDF fixture absences + 1 flaky phase1_server DuckDB lock race, 2x repeat pass). See U294, TL055, issue log v109.
